pokemon.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

pokemon.name: Ivysaur
pokemon.description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

pokemon.name: Venusaur
pokemon.description: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.

pokemon.name: Charmander
pokemon.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

pokemon.name: Charmeleon
pokemon.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

pokemon.name: Charizard
pokemon.description: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

pokemon.name: Squirtle
pokemon.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

pokemon.name: Wartortle
pokemon.description: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

pokemon.name: Blastoise
pokemon.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

pokemon.name: Caterpie
pokemon.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

pokemon.name: Metapod
pokemon.description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

pokemon.name: Butterfree
pokemon.description: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

pokemon.name: Weedle
pokemon.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

pokemon.name: Kakuna
pokemon.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

pokemon.name: Beedrill
pokemon.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

pokemon.name: Pidgey
pokemon.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

pokemon.name: Pidgeotto
pokemon.description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

pokemon.name: Pidgeot
pokemon.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

pokemon.name: Rattata
pokemon.description: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

pokemon.name: Raticate
pokemon.description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

pokemon.name: Spearow
pokemon.description: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

pokemon.name: Fearow
pokemon.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

pokemon.name: Ekans
pokemon.description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

pokemon.name: Arbok
pokemon.description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

pokemon.name: Pikachu
pokemon.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

pokemon.name: Raichu
pokemon.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

pokemon.name: Sandshrew
pokemon.description: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

pokemon.name: Sandslash
pokemon.description: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.

pokemon.name: Nidoran♀
pokemon.description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

pokemon.name: Nidorina
pokemon.description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

pokemon.name: Nidoqueen
pokemon.description: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

pokemon.name: Nidoran♂
pokemon.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

pokemon.name: Nidorino
pokemon.description: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

pokemon.name: Nidoking
pokemon.description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

pokemon.name: Clefairy
pokemon.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

pokemon.name: Clefable
pokemon.description: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

pokemon.name: Vulpix
pokemon.description: When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

pokemon.name: Ninetales
pokemon.description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

pokemon.name: Jigglypuff
pokemon.description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

pokemon.name: Wigglytuff
pokemon.description: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

pokemon.name: Zubat
pokemon.description: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

pokemon.name: Golbat
pokemon.description: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

pokemon.name: Oddish
pokemon.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

pokemon.name: Gloom
pokemon.description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

pokemon.name: Vileplume
pokemon.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

pokemon.name: Paras
pokemon.description: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

pokemon.name: Parasect
pokemon.description: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.

pokemon.name: Venonat
pokemon.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

pokemon.name: Venomoth
pokemon.description: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

pokemon.name: Diglett
pokemon.description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

pokemon.name: Dugtrio
pokemon.description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

pokemon.name: Meowth
pokemon.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokemon.name: Persian
pokemon.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

pokemon.name: Psyduck
pokemon.description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

pokemon.name: Golduck
pokemon.description: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.

pokemon.name: Mankey
pokemon.description: It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.

pokemon.name: Primeape
pokemon.description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

pokemon.name: Growlithe
pokemon.description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

pokemon.name: Arcanine
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

pokemon.name: Poliwag
pokemon.description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

pokemon.name: Poliwhirl
pokemon.description: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

pokemon.name: Poliwrath
pokemon.description: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

pokemon.name: Abra
pokemon.description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

pokemon.name: Kadabra
pokemon.description: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.

pokemon.name: Alakazam
pokemon.description: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.

pokemon.name: Machop
pokemon.description: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

pokemon.name: Machoke
pokemon.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

pokemon.name: Machamp
pokemon.description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

pokemon.name: Bellsprout
pokemon.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

pokemon.name: Weepinbell
pokemon.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

pokemon.name: Victreebel
pokemon.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

pokemon.name: Tentacool
pokemon.description: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

pokemon.name: Tentacruel
pokemon.description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokemon.name: Geodude
pokemon.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

pokemon.name: Graveler
pokemon.description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

pokemon.name: Golem
pokemon.description: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

pokemon.name: Ponyta
pokemon.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

pokemon.name: Rapidash
pokemon.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

pokemon.name: Slowpoke
pokemon.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

pokemon.name: Slowbro
pokemon.description: An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.

pokemon.name: Magnemite
pokemon.description: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

pokemon.name: Magneton
pokemon.description: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

pokemon.name: Farfetch'd
pokemon.description: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

pokemon.name: Doduo
pokemon.description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

pokemon.name: Dodrio
pokemon.description: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.

pokemon.name: Seel
pokemon.description: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

pokemon.name: Dewgong
pokemon.description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

pokemon.name: Grimer
pokemon.description: Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.

pokemon.name: Muk
pokemon.description: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

pokemon.name: Shellder
pokemon.description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

pokemon.name: Cloyster
pokemon.description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

pokemon.name: Gastly
pokemon.description: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

pokemon.name: Haunter
pokemon.description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

pokemon.name: Gengar
pokemon.description: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: Onix
pokemon.description: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

pokemon.name: Drowzee
pokemon.description: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

pokemon.name: Hypno
pokemon.description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

pokemon.name: Krabby
pokemon.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

pokemon.name: Kingler
pokemon.description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

pokemon.name: Voltorb
pokemon.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

pokemon.name: Electrode
pokemon.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

pokemon.name: Exeggcute
pokemon.description: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokemon.name: Exeggutor
pokemon.description: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.

pokemon.name: Cubone
pokemon.description: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

pokemon.name: Marowak
pokemon.description: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

pokemon.name: Hitmonlee
pokemon.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

pokemon.name: Hitmonchan
pokemon.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

pokemon.name: Lickitung
pokemon.description: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

pokemon.name: Koffing
pokemon.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

pokemon.name: Weezing
pokemon.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

pokemon.name: Rhyhorn
pokemon.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

pokemon.name: Rhydon
pokemon.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: Chansey
pokemon.description: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

pokemon.name: Tangela
pokemon.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

pokemon.name: Kangaskhan
pokemon.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

pokemon.name: Horsea
pokemon.description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

pokemon.name: Seadra
pokemon.description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

pokemon.name: Goldeen
pokemon.description: It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.

pokemon.name: Seaking
pokemon.description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

pokemon.name: Staryu
pokemon.description: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

pokemon.name: Starmie
pokemon.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

pokemon.name: Mr. Mime
pokemon.description: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

pokemon.name: Scyther
pokemon.description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

pokemon.name: Jynx
pokemon.description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

pokemon.name: Electabuzz
pokemon.description: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.

pokemon.name: Magmar
pokemon.description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: Pinsir
pokemon.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.

pokemon.name: Tauros
pokemon.description: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

pokemon.name: Magikarp
pokemon.description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

pokemon.name: Gyarados
pokemon.description: In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.

pokemon.name: Lapras
pokemon.description: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

pokemon.name: Ditto
pokemon.description: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

pokemon.name: Eevee
pokemon.description: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

pokemon.name: Vaporeon
pokemon.description: It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.

pokemon.name: Jolteon
pokemon.description: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.

pokemon.name: Flareon
pokemon.description: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.

pokemon.name: Porygon
pokemon.description: A man-made Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

pokemon.name: Omanyte
pokemon.description: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

pokemon.name: Omastar
pokemon.description: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

pokemon.name: Kabuto
pokemon.description: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokemon.name: Kabutops
pokemon.description: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

pokemon.name: Aerodactyl
pokemon.description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

pokemon.name: Snorlax
pokemon.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

pokemon.name: Articuno
pokemon.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

pokemon.name: Zapdos
pokemon.description: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

pokemon.name: Moltres
pokemon.description: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

pokemon.name: Dratini
pokemon.description: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokemon.name: Dragonair
pokemon.description: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

pokemon.name: Dragonite
pokemon.description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

pokemon.name: Mewtwo
pokemon.description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

pokemon.name: Mew
pokemon.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
